title: Sans Souci - Vacation Rental in Seacrest Beach West,FL | 30a Escapes
description_expanded: 30A ESCAPES presents..."Sans Souci," your next unforgettable getaway in Seacrest West! This cozy, pet-friendly (woof!) cottage is just a 5-min stroll to sugar-white sands. Enjoy the heated community pool just down the street, 4 provided bikes, and Roku TV for relaxation and fun. Bring all the crew and make lasting memories. “Sans Souci” means "without worry"—and that’s exactly how your escape will feel. Ready to experience it? Learn more below...*** HIGHLIGHTS ***Pet-Friendly Getaway: Share your vacation with your furry companion and create unforgettable memories together (fees and restrictions apply).Walking Distance to the Beach (5-min) & Community Pool (30-sec): Enjoy the ultimate convenience of a relaxing beach day or a refreshing swim moments away!4 Bikes Included: Explore the scenic beauty of 30A with ease, cruising along bike-friendly trails and enjoying the coastal breeze.Comfortable Stays for 8: Relax in style with 3 cozy bedrooms, each complete with its own private en-suite bathroom and smart TV.Newly Renovated Kitchen with Modern Appliances: Cook up delicious meals in style with a sleek, fully updated kitchen designed for comfort and creativity.Eager to Read More?Here Are A Few Kind Words From Our Previous Guests:⭐ “We had a wonderful time. The house was perfect and close to so many things!” - Lena W.⭐ "The house was perfect for our family vacation to 30a! Having the beach across the street and a short drive or bike ride to town was perfect. It will always be our go to spot!" - Peter S.⭐ "The house was great, a very easy walk to the private beach and plenty of space. Kitchen was well stocked. We loved the bikes as well. We would definitely stay again!" - Tim W.*** LIVING AREA ***The living area, the heart of the home, offers a bright and inviting atmosphere, complete with cozy, beach-inspired furniture that’s perfect for unwinding after a sun-filled day. Relax in this serene space with a cup of coffee while enjoying your favorite movies on the Roku-enabled TV.Open-concept layout ideal for families, offering plenty of space to relax, connect, and create lasting memories togetherRoku TV for endless entertainment, featuring streaming options to keep everyone entertained, from movies to your favorite showsComfortable, beachy furnishings that set the tone for a laid-back, relaxing getaway, perfectly complementing your vacation vibe*** KITCHEN AND DINING ***Create memorable meals in the beautifully renovated kitchen, featuring brand-new stainless-steel appliances, sleek countertops, and all the essentials for effortless cooking. The inviting dining area is ideal for family dinners, comfortably seating six around the table, with an additional four bar stools for casual bites or morning coffee.Sleek stainless-steel appliances for a modern and stylish touch, adding both functionality and elegance to your kitchen spaceSpacious dining area, designed to comfortably seat up to 10 guests, making it ideal for hosting family dinners or entertaining friendsFully equipped kitchen with high-quality tools and appliances, perfect for preparing everything from quick snacks to elaborate family meals with ease*** OUTDOOR & OTHER HOME PERKS ***Relax on the porch while enjoying the refreshing beach breeze, and listen to your favorite tunes with the provided Bluetooth speakerGrill up a delicious dinner on the outdoor grill, or host gatherings and enjoy al fresco meals with family and friendsLaunder your clothes and beach towels effortlessly with the high-capacity, high-efficiency washer and dryer located on the 1st floorRinse off the sugar-white sand in the outdoor shower conveniently located near the side entrance, ensuring a clean and fresh return from the beach*** COMMUNITY AMENITIES ***Heated pool just steps away (a quick 30-second walk), perfect for a refreshing dip or lounging by the water any time of day.Private beach access within a 5-minute stroll, offering pristine sand and stunning ocean views for a relaxing getaway.*** BEDROOMS & BATHROOMS ***1st Floor:Queen Room: Comfortable queen-sized bed, private en-suite with walk-in shower, flat-screen TV.Bunk Room: Two Twin-over-Twin bunk beds (sleeps 4), flat-screen TV/DVD player with access to the dedicated hall bathroom.Hall bathroom: with single sink and shower/tub combo.2nd Floor:Primary Suite: Luxurious King-sized bed with private balcony access and a smart TV. En-suite features dual sinks, a rain shower.*** LOCATION & COMMUNITY ***Tucked away in the tranquil Seacrest West community, Sans Souci offers an ideal blend of serenity and adventure. Enjoy easy access to dining, entertainment, and shopping, with popular destinations like Rosemary Beach, Alys Beach, and The Big Chill just minutes away.Alys Beach – Just a 7-minute bike ride away, this stunning coastal spot exudes elegance with its pristine white architecture and serene atmosphere.The Big Chill – Located 1.4 miles away, this vibrant hub offers live music, outdoor movies, and endless dining options, perfect for a lively night out.Rosemary Beach – Only a 5-minute drive, this charming town radiates a relaxed yet upscale vibe, with quaint streets, boutique shops, and cozy cafes.*** PET POLICY ***Maximum of 2 pets allowed.Pets are not allowed on furniture or beds.Must be kept in a crate when guests are not with their dog.Non-refundable pet fee: $250 + tax.*** OTHER THINGS TO KNOW ***Travel Insurance is NOT included but can be purchased separately.We DO NOT accept wire transfers for payment.Pet-friendly with a non-refundable $250 fee (up to 2 pets, restrictions apply).Waiver required to get access to the 4 provided bikes. Additional bikes can be rented through 30A Escapes.LSV (Low Speed Vehicles) are NOT allowed in Rosemary Beach, Seacrest, or Alys Beach.*** BOOK TODAY & START YOUR 30A ESCAPE! ***TDT #: 83392STRO #: STR-083392

Essentials: Olive Oil and Salt & Pepper Starter Supplies
